tables.name: areas
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE "areas" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "company_id" integer not null, "name" varchar not null, "city" varchar not null, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("company_id") references "companies"("id") on delete restrict)

tables.name: audit_logs
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE "audit_logs" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "company_id" integer not null, "actor_id" integer, "action" varchar not null, "subject_type" varchar not null, "subject_id" integer not null, "metadata" text, "created_at" datetime not null, foreign key("company_id") references "companies"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("actor_id") references "users"("id") on delete restrict)

tables.name: cache
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE "cache" ("key" varchar not null, "value" text not null, "expiration" integer not null, primary key ("key"))

tables.name: cache_locks
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE "cache_locks" ("key" varchar not null, "owner" varchar not null, "expiration" integer not null, primary key ("key"))

tables.name: cash_handovers
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE "cash_handovers" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "company_id" integer not null, "code" varchar not null, "collector_id" integer not null, "requested_by" integer not null, "amount_minor" integer not null, "status" varchar not null default 'pending', "reference" varchar not null, "note" varchar, "reviewed_by" integer, "reviewed_at" datetime, "review_note" varchar, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("company_id") references "companies"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("requested_by") references "users"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("reviewed_by") references "users"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("company_id", "collector_id") references "company_user"("company_id", "user_id") on delete restrict)

tables.name: collections
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE "collections" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "company_id" integer not null, "order_id" integer not null, "actor_id" integer not null, "receipt" varchar not null, "amount_minor" integer not null, "method" varchar not null, "collected_at" datetime not null, foreign key("company_id") references "companies"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("actor_id") references "users"("id"), foreign key("order_id", "company_id") references "orders"("id", "company_id") on delete restrict)

tables.name: companies
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE "companies" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "name" varchar not null, "slug" varchar not null, "industry" varchar not null default 'distribution', "timezone" varchar not null default 'Asia/Riyadh', "currency" varchar not null default 'SAR', "is_active" tinyint(1) not null default '1', "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime)

tables.name: company_user
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE "company_user" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "company_id" integer not null, "user_id" integer not null, "role" varchar not null default 'viewer', "is_active" tinyint(1) not null default '1', "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, "phone" varchar, "employee_code" varchar, "area_access" varchar not null default 'all', "can_sell" tinyint(1) not null default '1', "can_collect" tinyint(1) not null default '1', "notes" varchar, "operations_version" integer not null default '1', foreign key("company_id") references "companies"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("user_id") references "users"("id") on delete restrict)

tables.name: customer_changes
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE "customer_changes" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "company_id" integer not null, "customer_id" integer, "submitted_by" integer not null, "kind" varchar not null, "status" varchar not null default 'pending', "payload" text not null, "reviewed_by" integer, "review_note" text, "reviewed_at" datetime, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("company_id") references "companies"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("submitted_by") references "users"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("reviewed_by") references "users"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("customer_id", "company_id") references "customers"("id", "company_id") on delete restrict)

tables.name: customers
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE "customers" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "company_id" integer not null, "area_id" integer not null, "code" varchar not null, "name" varchar not null, "phone" varchar, "address" varchar not null, "latitude" numeric not null, "longitude" numeric not null, "geofence_radius_m" integer not null default ('150'), "is_active" tinyint(1) not null default ('1'), "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, "credit_limit_minor" integer, "representative_id" integer, "service_notes" text, "profile_version" integer not null default '1', foreign key("area_id", "company_id") references areas("id", "company_id") on delete restrict on update no action, foreign key("company_id") references companies("id") on delete restrict on update no action, foreign key("company_id", "representative_id") references "company_user"("company_id", "user_id") on delete restrict)

tables.name: debt_followups
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE "debt_followups" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "company_id" integer not null, "order_id" integer not null, "actor_id" integer not null, "outcome" varchar not null, "note" varchar not null, "next_followup_date" date not null, "promised_minor" integer, "created_at" datetime not null, foreign key("company_id") references "companies"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("actor_id") references "users"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("order_id", "company_id") references "orders"("id", "company_id") on delete restrict)

tables.name: drivers
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE "drivers" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "company_id" integer not null, "name" varchar not null, "phone" varchar, "employee_code" varchar not null, "license_number" varchar, "license_expires_on" date, "status" varchar not null default 'active', "notes" varchar, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("company_id") references "companies"("id") on delete restrict)

tables.name: failed_jobs
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE "failed_jobs" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "uuid" varchar not null, "connection" text not null, "queue" text not null, "payload" text not null, "exception" text not null, "failed_at" datetime not null default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

tables.name: job_batches
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE "job_batches" ("id" varchar not null, "name" varchar not null, "total_jobs" integer not null, "pending_jobs" integer not null, "failed_jobs" integer not null, "failed_job_ids" text not null, "options" text, "cancelled_at" integer, "created_at" integer not null, "finished_at" integer, primary key ("id"))

tables.name: jobs
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE "jobs" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "queue" varchar not null, "payload" text not null, "attempts" integer not null, "reserved_at" integer, "available_at" integer not null, "created_at" integer not null)

tables.name: location_points
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE "location_points" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "company_id" integer not null, "trip_id" integer not null, "user_id" integer not null, "event_id" varchar not null, "latitude" numeric not null, "longitude" numeric not null, "accuracy_m" integer not null, "speed_kmh" numeric, "captured_at" datetime not null, "received_at" datetime not null, "source" varchar not null default 'web', "quality" varchar not null default 'accepted', foreign key("company_id") references "companies"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("user_id") references "users"("id"), foreign key("trip_id", "company_id") references "trips"("id", "company_id") on delete restrict)

tables.name: migrations
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE "migrations" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "migration" varchar not null, "batch" integer not null)

tables.name: operation_receipts
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE "operation_receipts" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "company_id" integer not null, "user_id" integer not null, "request_id" varchar not null, "action" varchar not null, "payload_hash" varchar not null, "result" text, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("company_id") references "companies"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("user_id") references "users"("id"))

tables.name: order_items
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE "order_items" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "company_id" integer not null, "order_id" integer not null, "product_id" integer not null, "quantity" integer not null, "unit_price_minor" integer not null, "total_minor" integer not null, foreign key("company_id") references "companies"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("order_id", "company_id") references "orders"("id", "company_id") on delete restrict, foreign key("product_id", "company_id") references "products"("id", "company_id") on delete restrict)

tables.name: orders
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE "orders" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "company_id" integer not null, "code" varchar not null, "customer_id" integer not null, "representative_id" integer not null, "trip_id" integer, "warehouse_id" integer not null, "status" varchar not null default 'draft', "total_minor" integer not null default '0', "paid_minor" integer not null default '0', "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, "payment_terms" varchar not null default 'credit', "due_date" date, "initial_paid_minor" integer not null default '0', foreign key("company_id") references "companies"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("representative_id") references "users"("id"), foreign key("customer_id", "company_id") references "customers"("id", "company_id") on delete restrict, foreign key("trip_id", "company_id") references "trips"("id", "company_id") on delete restrict, foreign key("warehouse_id", "company_id") references "warehouses"("id", "company_id") on delete restrict)

tables.name: password_reset_tokens
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE "password_reset_tokens" ("email" varchar not null, "token" varchar not null, "created_at" datetime, primary key ("email"))

tables.name: personal_access_tokens
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE "personal_access_tokens" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "tokenable_type" varchar not null, "tokenable_id" integer not null, "name" text not null, "token" varchar not null, "abilities" text, "last_used_at" datetime, "expires_at" datetime, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime)

tables.name: products
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE "products" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "company_id" integer not null, "sku" varchar not null, "name" varchar not null, "unit" varchar not null default 'قطعة', "price_minor" integer not null, "reorder_level" integer not null default '20', "is_active" tinyint(1) not null default '1', "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("company_id") references "companies"("id") on delete restrict)

tables.name: representative_areas
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE "representative_areas" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "company_id" integer not null, "user_id" integer not null, "area_id" integer not null, foreign key("company_id", "user_id") references "company_user"("company_id", "user_id") on delete restrict, foreign key("area_id", "company_id") references "areas"("id", "company_id") on delete restrict)

tables.name: representative_vehicle_assignments
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE "representative_vehicle_assignments" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "company_id" integer not null, "representative_id" integer not null, "vehicle_id" integer not null, "active_representative_id" integer, "active_vehicle_id" integer, "assigned_by" integer not null, "returned_by" integer, "assigned_at" datetime not null, "returned_at" datetime, "assignment_note" text not null, "return_note" text, foreign key("company_id") references "companies"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("assigned_by") references "users"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("returned_by") references "users"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("company_id", "representative_id") references "company_user"("company_id", "user_id") on delete restrict, foreign key("vehicle_id", "company_id") references "vehicles"("id", "company_id") on delete restrict)

tables.name: sessions
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE "sessions" ("id" varchar not null, "user_id" integer, "ip_address" varchar, "user_agent" text, "payload" text not null, "last_activity" integer not null, primary key ("id"))

tables.name: stock_balances
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE "stock_balances" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "company_id" integer not null, "warehouse_id" integer not null, "product_id" integer not null, "quantity" integer not null default '0', "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("company_id") references "companies"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("warehouse_id", "company_id") references "warehouses"("id", "company_id") on delete restrict, foreign key("product_id", "company_id") references "products"("id", "company_id") on delete restrict)

tables.name: stock_movements
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE "stock_movements" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "company_id" integer not null, "warehouse_id" integer not null, "product_id" integer not null, "quantity" integer not null, "reason" varchar not null, "reference" varchar not null, "actor_id" integer, "created_at" datetime not null, foreign key("company_id") references "companies"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("actor_id") references "users"("id"), foreign key("warehouse_id", "company_id") references "warehouses"("id", "company_id") on delete restrict, foreign key("product_id", "company_id") references "products"("id", "company_id") on delete restrict)

tables.name: trips
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE "trips" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "company_id" integer not null, "code" varchar not null, "representative_id" integer not null, "vehicle_id" integer not null, "warehouse_id" integer not null, "scheduled_for" date not null, "status" varchar not null default ('planned'), "started_at" datetime, "closed_at" datetime, "active_representative_id" integer, "active_vehicle_id" integer, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, "driver_id" integer, "plan_version" integer not null default ('1'), "planning_notes" text, "cancelled_at" datetime, "cancelled_by" integer, "cancellation_reason" varchar, "weekly_plan_id" integer, "weekly_plan_version" integer, "route_snapshot" text, foreign key("cancelled_by") references users("id") on delete restrict on update no action, foreign key("warehouse_id", "company_id") references warehouses("id", "company_id") on delete restrict on update no action, foreign key("vehicle_id", "company_id") references vehicles("id", "company_id") on delete restrict on update no action, foreign key("company_id", "representative_id") references company_user("company_id", "user_id") on delete restrict on update no action, foreign key("company_id") references companies("id") on delete restrict on update no action, foreign key("driver_id", "company_id") references drivers("id", "company_id") on delete restrict on update no action, foreign key("weekly_plan_id", "company_id") references "weekly_plans"("id", "company_id") on delete restrict)

tables.name: users
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE "users" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "name" varchar not null, "email" varchar, "email_verified_at" datetime, "password" varchar not null, "remember_token" varchar, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, "username" varchar)

tables.name: vehicle_assignments
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE "vehicle_assignments" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "company_id" integer not null, "vehicle_id" integer not null, "driver_id" integer not null, "active_vehicle_id" integer, "active_driver_id" integer, "assigned_by" integer not null, "returned_by" integer, "assigned_at" datetime not null, "returned_at" datetime, "handover_note" varchar not null, "return_note" varchar, foreign key("company_id") references "companies"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("assigned_by") references "users"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("returned_by") references "users"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("vehicle_id", "company_id") references "vehicles"("id", "company_id") on delete restrict, foreign key("driver_id", "company_id") references "drivers"("id", "company_id") on delete restrict)

tables.name: vehicles
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE "vehicles" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "company_id" integer not null, "plate" varchar not null, "name" varchar not null, "status" varchar not null default 'available', "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, "capacity_units" integer not null default '500', "vehicle_type" varchar not null default 'unspecified', "make" varchar, "model" varchar, "model_year" integer, "vin" varchar, "ownership" varchar not null default 'owned', "payload_kg" integer, "volume_m3" numeric, "odometer_km" integer, "registration_expires_on" date, "insurance_expires_on" date, "notes" varchar, foreign key("company_id") references "companies"("id") on delete restrict)

tables.name: visits
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE "visits" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "company_id" integer not null, "customer_id" integer not null, "representative_id" integer not null, "scheduled_for" date not null, "status" varchar not null default ('planned'), "checked_in_at" datetime, "finished_at" datetime, "checkin_latitude" numeric, "checkin_longitude" numeric, "accuracy_m" numeric, "distance_m" numeric, "location_captured_at" datetime, "location_verified" tinyint(1) not null default ('0'), "outcome_note" varchar, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, "trip_id" integer, "sequence" integer not null default '1', "window_start" time, "window_end" time, "service_minutes" integer not null default '10', "reason_code" varchar, foreign key("company_id", "representative_id") references company_user("company_id", "user_id") on delete restrict on update no action, foreign key("customer_id", "company_id") references customers("id", "company_id") on delete restrict on update no action, foreign key("company_id") references companies("id") on delete restrict on update no action, foreign key("trip_id", "company_id") references "trips"("id", "company_id") on delete restrict)

tables.name: warehouses
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE "warehouses" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "company_id" integer not null, "name" varchar not null, "type" varchar not null default 'warehouse', "vehicle_id" integer, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("company_id") references "companies"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("vehicle_id", "company_id") references "vehicles"("id", "company_id") on delete restrict)

tables.name: weekly_plans
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE "weekly_plans" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "company_id" integer not null, "representative_id" integer not null, "vehicle_id" integer not null, "weekday" integer not null, "customer_ids" text not null, "origin_latitude" numeric not null, "origin_longitude" numeric not null, "origin_label" varchar not null, "notes" text, "is_active" tinyint(1) not null default '1', "version" integer not null default '1', "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("company_id") references "companies"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("company_id", "representative_id") references "company_user"("company_id", "user_id") on delete restrict, foreign key("vehicle_id", "company_id") references "vehicles"("id", "company_id") on delete restrict)
